description_en: Stops log delivery from a connected cloud service. Once stopped, no new logs are added to your Logstore
description_zh: 关闭某个已经接入的云产品日志的投递，关闭后用户侧的LogStore里不再有对应日志的新内容
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem close-delivery --product-code sas --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloseDelivery

parameters.help_en: The code of the log within the cloud service. For example, the process log of Security Center. For valid values, see the return value of the ListDelivery operation
parameters.help_zh: 云产品下的日志code，比如云安全中心的进程日志，取值参考ListDelivery的返回值

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts in your enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of a member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of threat analysis is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Select this region if your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

ap-southeast-1: Select this region if your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id
